rules.explanation: Sugar exceeds the illustrative development threshold (20g/100g).

rules.label: trans fat

rules.label: total fat
rules.explanation: High total fat (>25g/100g), typical of deep-fried Indian namkeen, bhujia, and potato chips.

rules.label: saturated fat
rules.explanation: High in saturated fat (>8g/100g). Commercial Indian packaged snacks heavily rely on refined palmolein (palm oil).

rules.label: sodium
rules.explanation: High sodium (>500mg/100g, exceeding FSSAI HFSS benchmark). A standard 100g pack provides over 25% of ICMR's 2,000 mg daily limit.

rules.label: sugar
rules.explanation: Elevated sugar (>10g/100g) in a savory snack product.

rules.label: trans fat
rules.explanation: Contains trans fat (>0.2g/100g), which is strictly regulated by FSSAI.

rules.label: sugar
rules.explanation: High sugar for beverages (>5g/100ml, FSSAI HFSS liquid threshold). A single 250ml can contains over 6 teaspoons of sugar.

rules.label: saturated fat
rules.explanation: Elevated saturated fat (>1.5g/100ml) for a liquid beverage.

rules.label: sodium
rules.explanation: Elevated sodium (>100mg/100ml) for a packaged drink.

rules.label: sodium
rules.explanation: Critically high sodium (>650mg/100g). Instant noodles and tastemakers often contain over 60% of an adult's entire daily salt allowance.

rules.label: saturated fat
rules.explanation: High saturated fat (>5g/100g), typically resulting from flash-frying noodles in refined palm oil.

rules.label: trans fat
rules.explanation: Contains trans fat (>0.2g/100g).

rules.label: sugar
rules.explanation: Extremely high sugar (>25g/100g). Exceeds the ICMR recommended daily added sugar ceiling (25g) in just 100g.

rules.label: saturated fat
rules.explanation: High saturated fat (>10g/100g) from cocoa butter, dairy fats, or hydrogenated vegetable oils.

rules.label: trans fat
rules.explanation: Contains trans fat (>0.2g/100g).

rules.label: sugar
rules.explanation: High sugar (>15g/100g) for breakfast foods. Many sweetened cereals in India contain heavy sugar glazes.

rules.label: sodium

rules.label: saturated fat
rules.explanation: Elevated saturated fat (>3g/100g).

rules.label: sugar
rules.explanation: High sugar (>8g/100g). Natural lactose in milk is ~4.5g; higher values represent substantial added refined sugars.

rules.label: sodium
